mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) over the past month signals higher inflation expectations that prompt the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.2% in the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase above 5.5% signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises above 5.5% in the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% in the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a monthly CPIAUCSL increase above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that forces the central bank to maintain high rates, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO rises by more than 0.5% in the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1700 thousand units in the past month, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls below 1700, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces household income and consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth demand regime (RSAFS > 600,000 million dollars), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1700 thousand units signals a weakening in the housing sector that reduces overall consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS > 600,000 and HOUST < 1700, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
